rust_boundary_requirements.required: Inspect the prepared artifact: one generic declaration body, dedicated physical layout identities retaining construction/declaration order provenance, distinct verified name slots for narrow/wide and permuted physical layouts, nested slot evidence, and callsite/producer-boundary preparation. Semantic label normalization cannot substitute for physical layout identity. Native stdout alone does not prove body sharing or slot preparation.

Prepare via the normal frontend/checker/lowerer, drop frontend/inference/builder state, then execute the same artifact on the compact driver and forced recursive indexed route; assert exact row and Add results plus forwarded evidence ownership.

Mutate prepared artifacts to reject foreign/missing evidence, wrong or out-of-range field slots, layout/type mismatches, unsupported or absent sealed operation evidence, invalid quantifier scope/arity, and evidence remaining after builder checkpoint rewind. Native source cannot construct these private invalid artifacts.

Counters/artifact inspection must prove no per-item name search, runtime type inference/overload search, source parse, per-shape body clone, or AST evaluator fallback; preserve existing direct monomorphic operation paths.
